title: Transition classification and raw detector-policy freeze

acceptance_conditions.condition: CEAR-G6 and C2AR-G6A are PASS and merged
Transition classes distinguish measurement categorical structural reference and computability change
Object identity change is explicitly not a crossing
Directional crossing requires same immutable object and ordered M1/tick path
OHLC and precision-touch evidence cannot silently become semantic interaction
Detectors have no active canonical or numeric-threshold authority
Approach test reject accept event episode and outcome labels remain prohibited
Rollback and versioned supersession are defined
Gate branch complete repository FINAL_HEAD and merge-readiness checks pass with zero unresolved threads

warnings.warning: No numeric proximity, persistence, acceptance, rejection or hysteresis threshold is selected at this gate.
The six detectors emit raw evidence only; semantic interaction, event and episode policy remains outside this approval.
Parent-context resolver authority remains reserved for CEAR-G8.

rollback.before_pass: Close or supersede the gate proposal. Candidate registries remain non-effective.
rollback.after_pass_before_implementation: Record DEFER or SUPERSEDE through a new operator decision; do not mutate the PASS record.
rollback.after_implementation: Create a new versioned supersession packet. Preserve accepted class and detector IDs, hashes, evidence and decisions.

decision_effect_if_pass: Approve the transition classification and six raw detector policies for inactive noncanonical SHADOW_FROZEN implementation only, with every explicitly-not-granted authority remaining denied.
exact_work_after_approval: Record and merge the operator CEAR-G7 decision.
Materialise transition and detector contracts schemas registries fixtures and implementation.
Run deterministic synthetic and authorised sealed-source shadow comparisons.
Auto-ratify and merge bounded non-reserved WP7 implementation QA if all conditions pass.
Prepare CEAR-G8 parent-context resolver decision and stop before granting resolver authority.
